title: The Orlando Innamorato
author: Matteo Maria Boiardo
description: "The Orlando Innamorato" by Matteo Maria Boiardo is an epic poem published between 1483 and 1495.
longDescription: The beautiful Angelica arrives at Charlemagne's court, sparking a chaotic pursuit by love-struck knights, especially the heroic Orlando and Rinaldo.

authorInfo.bio: Matteo Maria Boiardo (1440–1494) wrote The Orlando Innamorato. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
